title: Zesty Glassy Jelly Syrian Pickles Tagine
description: A unique and flavorful dish combining the tanginess of pickles with the sweetness of glassy jelly, in a traditional Syrian earthenware bowl.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cucumbers, red wine vinegar, sugar substitute, and water. Let it sit at room temperature for 2 hours.
Add sliced red cabbage and minced garlic to the bowl and toss well.
Add sage leaves, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and toss again.
Transfer the mixture to an earthenware bowl and cover it with a lid.
Bake in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 30 minutes.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the Zesty Glassy Jelly Syrian Pickles Tagine warm or at room temperature.
Garnish with additional sage leaves, if desired.
